arguments.command:
python -c "
import humanize

# Test intcomma with ndigits=0
print('Testing intcomma with ndigits=0:')
test_cases = [
    (1234.5678, '1,235'),  # rounded to nearest integer
    (1234.0, '1,234'),     # exact integer
    (1234.4, '1,234'),     # rounds down
    (1234.5, '1,235'),     # rounds up
    (-1234.5678, '-1,235'),
    (1000000.0, '1,000,000'),
]

for value, expected in test_cases:
    result = humanize.intcomma(value, ndigits=0)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else f'✗ (got {result!r})'
    print(f'  intcomma({value}, ndigits=0) = {result!r} {status}')

# Also verify it still works normally without ndigits
print('\nTesting intcomma without ndigits:')
print(f'  intcomma(1234.5678) = {humanize.intcomma(1234.5678)!r}')
print(f'  intcomma(1234) = {humanize.intcomma(1234)!r}')
"
